tool.name: read-spill
tool.description:
Reads back the full text of an oversized tool result that was spilled to the session spill store (design §3.3). Use when a tool result contains a [SPILL_REF id=...] marker: the inline preview is truncated but the full content is retrievable.
**Parameters**: - `id`: the spill id from the [SPILL_REF id=...] marker in the inline preview (e.g. "sess-1-spill-1-xxxx").
**Semantics**: - Returns the full spilled tool-result text as a normal tool result (may itself be spilled/truncated again if oversized; SPILL_REF nesting is allowed). - An unknown or expired id returns an explicit error — the id is session-scoped and in-memory; it becomes invalid after a crash/restart (re-run the tool that produced it). - Not subject to activeTags filtering (meta tool).
